title: Load your first CSV
description: Every pipeline starts with a little raw data.
intro: A customer export just landed. Bring it into the Bronze layer exactly as it arrived. No cleaning, no clever transformations — yet.
objectives: Create a table named bronze_customers from customers.csv.
Keep all four columns as VARCHAR (raw text).
Preserve all 3 rows, including whitespace and duplicates.
hints: Use CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE … AS SELECT … to make your query rerunnable.
DuckDB reads files with read_csv('customers.csv', header = true, all_varchar = true).
